request: Analyze GSE230102 for PMID 37178122 (Conserved multi-tissue transcriptomic adaptations to exercise training in humans and mice.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Effect of 30 d voluntary wheel running (TRN) vs sedentary (SED) on quadriceps skeletal muscle gene expression in female HMDP mice, pooled across strains (S2.1.p1, S2.4.p3).
planned_contrasts: TRN vs SED in quadriceps skeletal muscle across all strains (S2.4.p3; per-tissue DEG count shown only in figures, not in text)
final.paper_method: kallisto v0.45 counts -> DESeq2 v1.28.0, corrected using limma v3.44.1 for library prep batch and sequencing flow-cell lane (S4.4.1.p2)

factors.strain: HMDP inbred strain; mice of each strain randomized to SED or TRN (S2.1.p1)

final.inclusion: female mice; GEO holds one SED and one TRN animal per strain per tissue (50 strains; the paper describes a 100-strain panel)
final.paper_results: No per-tissue DEG counts in text. 'top 500 DEGs from each tissue (the average number of DEGs in a tissue)' (S2.9.p3); BAT has the most DEGs (S2.8.p1); liver and heart fewer DEGs than muscle and gWAT (S2.6.p1, S2.7.p1); Slc25a1, Acly, Ccn1 and Dusp1 DE in all tissues except liver (S2.9.p1).

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p1: mice from each strain randomly divided into TRN or SED, 30 d in-cage wheel. S4.3.6.1.p1: quadriceps, gWAT, heart, BAT and liver sequenced. S4.4.1.p2: kallisto + DESeq2 with limma correction for library prep batch and flow-cell lane. S4.4.1.p3 and Figure 5A/6A legends: FDR < 0.05, no fold-change rule. Each tissue is a separate TRN vs SED comparison.

checks: S4.1.3.p1 and TAB1 name GSE230102 as 'RNAsequencing Exc HMDP, This paper'
GEO extract protocol matches S4.3.6.1.p1; data_processing names kallisto v0.45 / Ensembl v97 as in S4.4.1.p2
matrix GSE230102_quad.counts.txt.gz columns all end with _quadriceps and equal GEO titles of this tissue

ownership.reasoning: The accession is the paper's own deposit for the ExcHMDP tissues; the per-tissue count file is used.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns equal the GEO title (inspect alignment_keys). The first number of the title is the HMDP strain code (checked 1:1 with the strain characteristic across all 499 samples: 50 codes, 50 strains); recoded to S<n> so it is categorical. grp comes from the exercise-group characteristic.
